description:
Tae-In is from the street and labeled as an ex-convict. So far, his world has been a passive life centered around the gangster, Beom-Jae, whom he met in prison.
Then one day, Tae-In happened to witness a murder case, and meets Dan-U, the prosecutor in charge of the case. He loses consciousness from the overwhelming pheromones. Dan-U, who shows kindness to Tae-In, who seems mentally unstable, leaves a deep footprint in his life, which only Beom-Jae has done before... 

Between a gangster and a prosecutor, a passionate omega ex-convict from the street.
Will he be able to escape from the shadows of misfortune?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
